about_the_game:
Quiet Soul is a 3D horror-puzzle experience that puts you inside an abandoned

mansion filled with secrets and mysteries. Designed for players who enjoy exploration,

problem-solving, and immersive atmospheres, the game challenges you to use your

wits to navigate its eerie halls and unlock hidden areas.

Key Features:

  • Exploration-Focused Gameplay: Discover every room and corner of the mansion, uncovering clues and objects that help you progress.

  • Challenging Puzzles: Solve intricate puzzles by connecting scattered notes, symbols, and items, testing your observation and logic skills.

  • Immersive Environment: Realistic, high-quality 3D visuals create a tense and atmospheric experience, making you feel truly alone in the mansion.

  • Nonlinear Progression: Explore at your own pace. The mansion gradually reveals its secrets as you solve puzzles, without constant enemies or combat distractions.

  • Mystery & Suspense: While the story unfolds subtly through environmental storytelling and clues, the focus is on exploration, suspense, and the thrill of discovery.

  • Escape the Mansion: Your ultimate goal is to find a way out, piecing together clues and solving puzzles along the way.

Quiet Soul offers hours of engaging gameplay where every step and discovery brings

you closer to escaping the mansion. It’s a game for those who enjoy immersive horror,

clever puzzles, and atmospheric storytelling without relying on constant threats or

action sequences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Explore a mysterious mansion, solve puzzles, and uncover its secrets to escape.
